body: AMENDED_FOUNDER_AUTHORITY_20260827; SCORE_80_CRITICAL_PATH_ONLY. C5_POLICY=APPROVED: CATEGORY_UNKNOWN, ambiguous, and bundle classification fail closed into manual-review quarantine; no provider call, publication, spend, or downstream irreversible action while quarantined; only explicitly authorized human review role may release; heuristic auto-map NOT_AUTHORIZED. PAYMENT_CANARY_POSTURE=APPROVED_IN_PRINCIPLE_ONLY: closed/internal real-money canary; max 1 transaction; aggregate exposure <= IDR 50000; no public payment enablement; exactly-once required; provider receipt + DB state + reconciliation required; ambiguous provider/payment result STOP_NO_RETRY; settlement/refund fail-closed; DO_NOT_EXECUTE until merchant/provider prerequisites and authoritative price/COGS valid. RELEASE_CONTROL_MODEL=APPROVED: separate accountable Release Approver and Release Operator roles; explicit Rollback Authority; do not invent names/authority. PRIORITY=close deterministic rubric remediation; normalize acquired managed evidence; no unrelated implementation. REQUIRED_OUTPUT=exact 58-to-80 point matrix, 80-vs-90 classification, PITR_REQUIRED_FOR_80 determination, price/COGS fields, missing role assignments. Production/public/real-money remain OFF except future canary only after all listed prerequisites.
